welcome.title: For dua, there are times when the doors open
welcome.body: Ijaba alerts you at those times — the last third of the night, the Friday hour, between adhan and iqama. And you choose which ones reach you.

location.title: Where are you?
location.subtitle: Prayer times are calculated on your device — never sent to a server.
location.manual_hint: For travel, or if you'd rather not share your location

permissions.title: So the alert reaches you
permissions.body: Three steps. The third is the one everyone forgets — without it, your phone stops alerts while you sleep.
permissions.notifications_hint: A normal permission the system asks for once.
permissions.exact_alarms_hint: Not asked automatically — we open the setting for you.
permissions.battery_hint_brand: A {brand} setting the system never mentions. Without it, the phone stops the alert while you sleep.
permissions.battery_hint_generic: Some phones stop apps in the background. Let Ijaba run so alerts arrive.
permissions.later: I'll do it later — alerts may not arrive

dua_preview.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
dua_preview.meaning: O Allah, You are the One who pardons, and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
dua_preview.transliteration: Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul afwa fa'fu anni
